name: Ragas
summary: Open-source evaluation toolkit for LLM apps and agents: LLM-based and traditional metrics for RAG and agent workflows, plus automatic test-set generation.
description: Score retrieval-augmented generation and agent runs with ready-made metrics (LLM-judged and non-LLM), generate production-aligned test datasets when you do not have one, and plug into LangChain and common observability tools. Install with `pip install ragas`. The project now lives at `vibrantlabsai/ragas` (Vibrant Labs).
